description: The Head of Internal Communications must decide whether to combine two employee-resource-group forums that have begun competing for attendance and leadership attention, then establish safeguards so the combined forum is workable and trusted.

shared_context.S1: The Northstar and Mosaic employee-resource groups currently hold separate monthly forums, and their next two forums are scheduled for the same week.
shared_context.S2: Mara has authority to approve a combined forum and its temporary operating rules.
shared_context.S3: Attendance has declined at both forums since the groups began sharing several company-wide initiatives.
shared_context.S4: Mara's standing practice is to conduct a documented review in the current decision meeting: each ERG chair, the HR business partner, and the executive sponsor gets one uninterrupted initial turn to state relevant concerns, constraints, policy requirements, or prior commitments. During that initial turn, any such item must be entered using the formal disclosure action, not merely described in a conversational statement. After all four formal disclosures, Mara summarizes the record, asks the group to confirm it, and may decide in that same meeting.

PF1.text: Devin personally observed exactly three recent Northstar-Mosaic forum incidents in which Mosaic participants were interrupted before finishing. He has not entered those observations in the formal forum record because the chairs have been trying to resolve the tension informally. For this proposed combined forum, the appropriate safeguard is specifically a neutral external facilitator: an internal rotating facilitator from either ERG would not address the concern.

PF2.text: Leila has an approved caregiving arrangement that requires the recurring combined forum itself to run from 14:00 through 15:00 exactly; the forum must start at 14:00 and end at 15:00, not merely finish by 15:00. The arrangement is recorded with HR but has not yet been added to the forum calendar.

PF3.text: Grant confirmed that an ERG merger must run as a 60-day pilot, with written opt-in from both chairs and a formal midpoint review on day 30. The draft merger plan was prepared before he completed that policy check.

PF4.text: Sofia promised both chairs in a prior sponsor meeting that any combined forum would preserve a separate confidential-intake channel for each ERG and include exactly two sponsor check-ins during the pilot. The promise was never added to the draft charter.

decisions.facilitator: string; must be exactly 'neutral external facilitator'

acceptance_conditions: The two forums must be approved for combination.
The combined forum's record must state exactly three observed interruption incidents.
A neutral external facilitator must be appointed, not an internal rotating facilitator.
The recurring forum must run from 14:00 through 15:00.
The combination must be a 60-day pilot with a midpoint review on day 30 and written opt-in from both chairs.
Each ERG must retain a separate confidential-intake channel.
Exactly two sponsor check-ins must occur during the pilot.

content_checks.C5: decisions['pilot_days'] == 60 and decisions['midpoint_review_day'] == 30 and decisions['written_chair_opt_in'] == True

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Devin's exactly three observed interruptions changes the documented incident count to 3 and changes the safeguard choice from an ordinary internal facilitator to a neutral external facilitator.
Leila's approved caregiving arrangement changes the recurring forum schedule to the exact 14:00 start and 15:00 end.
Grant's confirmed policy changes the merger structure to exactly a 60-day pilot, a day-30 midpoint review, and written opt-in from both chairs.
Sofia's prior promise changes the charter to preserve separate confidential-intake channels and schedule exactly two sponsor check-ins during the pilot.
